title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Minister Shri C. R. Paatil highlighting efforts to build climate-resilient water management and ensure water security
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Union Minister, Shri C. R. Paatil.
The Prime Minister noted that water security is a shared responsibility that calls for stronger systems, scientific solutions and Jan Bhagidari. He added that the Union Minister writes on India’s efforts to build climate-resilient water management through the Jal Jeevan Mission, Namami Gange, water conservation and technology-driven solutions, providing an insightful perspective on how people’s participation, alongside sustained efforts across States and communities, can help secure water for future generations in a sustainable way.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Water security is a shared responsibility that calls for stronger systems, scientific solutions and Jan Bhagidari.
Union Minister Shri @CRPaatil writes on India’s efforts to build climate-resilient water management through the Jal Jeevan Mission, Namami Gange, water conservation and technology-driven solutions.
An insightful perspective on how people’s participation, alongside sustained efforts across States and communities, can help secure water for future generations in a sustainable way.”
